charts.title: WASP-32 b: orbits around Parumleo
charts.description: The orbits of Parumleo's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-32 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ivshina & Winn 2022 (2022ApJS..259...62I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname IVSHINA__AMP__WINN_2022): P 2.71866151 d

charts.title: WASP-32 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-32 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (42) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 427332229, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
